description: ACTION on the WooCommerce store. Changes regular_price and/or sale_price (or clears the sale with clear_sale_price=true) of one product or variation. Changes beyond the safety limit (default ±50% vs the current price) are refused. Returns before → after. In safe mode the first call returns a PREVIEW with confirm_id: show it and call again with confirm_id only after the user approves.

clear_sale_price.description: true = rimuove il prezzo in offerta.

confirm_id.description: Token di conferma ritornato dall'anteprima. Ripassa lo STESSO payload + confirm_id per eseguire davvero la scrittura.

regular_price.description: Prezzo di listino WooCommerce, stringa decimale, es. "19.90".

sale_price.description: Prezzo in offerta WooCommerce, stringa decimale, es. "14.90".

name: woo_update_price
